name: Owner.com
oneLiner: All-in-one platform for independent restaurants: AI-built website, commission-free online ordering, branded app, automated marketing and loyalty, and now POS and AI phone ordering.
bestFor: Independent and small multi-location restaurants that want more direct, commission-free orders and less reliance on third-party delivery apps.

updates.text: Raised a $240M Series D led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives at a $2.3B valuation, to expand from restaurant ordering and marketing into an AI operating system for local businesses.
Product scope now includes a restaurant POS and AI phone ordering that takes real orders by phone, alongside websites, ordering and marketing.

features: AI-built restaurant website optimized for search
Automated SMS and email marketing based on order history
AI phone ordering that places orders directly

pricing.text: Flex: $249/month plus 5% restaurant fee per order. Flat Rate: $499/month with no restaurant order fee. Both plans include the same features, with no long-term contract. Guests pay a 5% order support fee; card processing is 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction (per Owner's blog).

notes: Case-study results (sales lifts, fees saved) are vendor-reported, not used. Exact launch dates for Owner POS and AI phone ordering not found; timing rests on the Aug 2026 Series D coverage. Owner says it passed $100M ARR (company figure). Fit: built for independents, not large chains; consider this when placing it in a 'chain management' list. Current review's 'Pricing: available on request' is outdated: Owner publishes pricing.
